integrity: The exact value is proved from the false-twin leaf structure of the inversion coset, an explicit locating coloring, and an invariant-factor count of isolated involutions. Finite enumeration is used only as a replay.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to generalized dihedral groups with finite abelian kernel.
It does not determine locating chromatic numbers for arbitrary semidirect products or all finite groups.
An equivalent theorem could exist under alternate cyclic-graph or locating-coloring terminology.
title: Locating chromatic number of generalized-dihedral enhanced power graphs
